{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu_cla #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire cin,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);
    localparam PAD = 4 * BLOCKS;
    wire [PAD-1:0] p, g;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] gp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS:0] bc;
    wire [PAD-1:0] full_sum;
    genvar i, k, l;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PAD; i = i+1) begin: bits_pg
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign p[i] = a[i] ^ b[i];
                assign g[i] = a[i] & b[i];
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k+1) begin: blocks
            wire [4:0] c;
            assign gp[0][k] = p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k];
            assign gg[0][k] = g[4*k+3]
                | (p[4*k+3] & g[4*k+2])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]);
            assign c[0] = bc[k];
            assign c[1] = g[4*k] | (p[4*k] & c[0]);
            assign c[2] = g[4*k+1] | (p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                | (p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & c[0]);
            assign c[3] = g[4*k+2] | (p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & c[0]);
            assign c[4] = gg[0][k] | (gp[0][k] & c[0]);
            assign full_sum[4*k +: 4] = p[4*k +: 4] ^ c[3:0];
        end
        for (l = 0; l < LEVELS; l = l+1) begin: prefix_levels
            for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k+1) begin: prefix_blocks
                if (k >= (1 << l)) begin: combine
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k] & gp[l][k-(1 << l)];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k]
                        | (gp[l][k] & gg[l][k-(1 << l)]);
                end else begin: pass_through
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k];
                end
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k+1) begin: block_carries
            assign bc[k+1] = gg[LEVELS][k] | (gp[LEVELS][k] & cin);
        end
    endgenerate
    assign bc[0] = cin;
    assign sum = full_sum[WIDTH-1:0];
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result, sub_ab, sub_ba;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_or, bit_and, bit_xor, bit_xnor;
    wire [6:0] select_op;
    pw_alu_cla #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) add_unit (
        .a(a), .b(b), .cin(1'b0), .sum(add_result)
    );
    pw_alu_cla #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) sub_ab_unit (
        .a(a), .b(~b), .cin(1'b1), .sum(sub_ab)
    );
    pw_alu_cla #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) sub_ba_unit (
        .a(b), .b(~a), .cin(1'b1), .sum(sub_ba)
    );
    assign bit_or = a | b;
    assign bit_and = a & b;
    assign bit_xor = a ^ b;
    assign bit_xnor = a ~^ b;
    assign select_op[0] = (Oper == 3'b000);
    assign select_op[1] = (Oper == 3'b001);
    assign select_op[2] = (Oper == 3'b010);
    assign select_op[3] = (Oper == 3'b011);
    assign select_op[4] = (Oper == 3'b100);
    assign select_op[5] = (Oper == 3'b101);
    assign select_op[6] = (Oper == 3'b110);
    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{select_op[0]}} & add_result)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[1]}} & sub_ab)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[2]}} & sub_ba)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[3]}} & bit_or)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[4]}} & bit_and)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[5]}} & bit_xor)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[6]}} & bit_xnor);
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index = 0; index < STAGES-1; index = index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The measured critical paths traverse the registered-input ALU and final output selection. The mapped paths suggest substantial arithmetic/control interaction, although mapped names alone do not identify the original expressions.",
  "rewrite": "Compute addition and both subtraction directions independently of opcode using four-bit carry-lookahead blocks and a logarithmic block-prefix network. Select completed arithmetic and logical results with parallel mutually exclusive masks. Keep the entire sequential pipeline, reset structure, register names and state encodings unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The intended gain comes from bounding carry depth and keeping opcode decoding out of the arithmetic carry networks. At WIDTH=16, four carry-lookahead blocks require only two block-prefix levels. A positive WNS improvement is plausible, but its magnitude and even its sign require the specified mapping and STA; no new timing measurement is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Three parallel arithmetic networks trade logic area for shorter control-dependent paths. Common propagate and logical expressions may be shared during synthesis. No registers or pipeline stages are added. Compliance with the 4573.511360um2 cap and electrical limits remains to be measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "All operations remain unsigned WIDTH-bit modular operations; opcode 111 returns zero. WIDTH remains parameterized, including nonmultiples of four, and the original STAGES structure is retained. Synchronous reset, every registered latency, valid propagation and data updates during invalid cycles are unchanged. No initial-state relation, initialization, startup delay or input restriction is introduced. Existing named sequential state is preserved, so the first reset and arbitrary later resets retain the original behavior."
}
